open_points.subject: R0-14 conflict-copy classification
open_points.question: By what exact, versioned rule does the deliverer recognize a Syncthing conflict copy, including filename pattern, case handling and files in subfolders?
options: Match upstream Syncthing's current default pattern
Receive conflict status from Syncthing metadata rather than infer it from the filename
open_points.default_guess: Match the deployed Syncthing-fork's configured conflict-filename pattern throughout the photo-folder tree.

witness.initial: The photo folder contains a normal-looking image whose name resembles, but does not exactly match, a Syncthing conflict filename.
events: The deliverer scans the photo folder.
The owner opens the workplace's ready-photo list.
outcomes: The deliverer classifies the image as a conflict copy and excludes it.
The deliverer classifies the image as an ordinary photo and offers it.

open_points.subject: R0-14 workplace behavior
open_points.text: The deliverer does not offer such a copy.
open_points.question: Does "does not offer" mean the conflict copy is entirely absent from the workplace, or visible there as excluded with a reason?
options: Hide it from the ready-photo list
Show it disabled with a conflict-copy reason
Show a separate count or warning without listing the file
open_points.default_guess: Show it disabled with a conflict-copy reason so the owner can understand why a folder file is unavailable.

witness.initial: A conflict copy exists beneath the confirmed photo folder.
outcomes: The file is absent and the owner receives no explanation.
The file is visible but cannot be selected, with an explanation that it is a conflict copy.

open_points.subject: R0-14 delivery-time enforcement
open_points.text: The deliverer does not offer such a copy.
open_points.question: If a selected ordinary photo becomes or is replaced by a conflict copy after it was offered but before placement or publication, must the calling flow reject it, or may it complete the selected delivery?
options: Recheck immediately before placement and fail that photo
Recheck before each placement and publication step
Honor the earlier selection and deliver the selected content
open_points.default_guess: Recheck immediately before placement and fail that photo with a conflict-copy reason while continuing the other chosen photos.

witness.initial: An ordinary photo has been offered and selected, but delivery has not started.
events: Syncthing resolves concurrent edits and moves the selected version to a conflict-copy filename.
The calling flow processes the selection.
outcomes: The calling flow rejects that photo because it is now a conflict copy.
The calling flow delivers the previously selected content because it was ordinary when offered.
witness.observer: The owner and any later Portal reviewer

open_points.subject: R0-14 owner rename action
open_points.text: the owner who wants that version renames it, after which it is an ordinary photo
open_points.question: What exact rename makes the file ordinary, and when must the renamed file become eligible for the ready-photo list?
options: Any filesystem rename event makes it ordinary
It becomes ordinary only when its new name no longer matches the conflict-copy rule
The owner must move it out and back into the photo folder under a non-conflict name
open_points.default_guess: It becomes ordinary when a scan sees the same content at a name that no longer matches the conflict-copy rule, and it is then eligible under the normal content-identity rules.

witness.initial: A conflict copy is excluded from delivery.
events: The owner renames it but leaves a conflict-style marker in the new filename.
The deliverer scans the folder again.
outcomes: The file is offered because any rename clears conflict status.
The file remains excluded because its new name still matches the conflict-copy rule.
